rationale: The Court is likely to reverse on a narrow procedural ground emphasizing Banister’s finality/sequence rule: a plaintiff must satisfy Rule 59(e) or 60(b) to vacate judgment before Rule 15(a)/Foman can be invoked, and the Second Circuit erred by effectively collapsing those steps. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters to reject any categorical forfeiture gloss and from one or more majority justices (especially Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch) to stress that repeated refusals to amend make Rule 60(b) relief particularly hard to justify.
